issues.description: Static method name for computing a meal's total price is inconsistent across the exercise artifacts. The problem statement UML and text require a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int (see problem_statement.md). The solution implementation defines a static method named computeMealCost(Meal) in SealSaloon (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java) but the commented example in the solution's Main calls calculateTotalPrice (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java). The template's commented Main calls computeMealCost (template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java). This split — problem statement asking for calculateTotalPrice while code uses computeMealCost in some places — creates ambiguity for students about which method name to implement and which name the automated tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across the problem statement, template, and solution. Either: (a) change the problem statement/UML to require computeMealCost(Meal): int, or (b) rename the static method in SealSaloon from computeMealCost to calculateTotalPrice and update all calls in template and solution Main to calculateTotalPrice. Ensure the example usages in Main and the UML/text all reference the same identifier so students and tests target a single API.
